_about: Sikh openings in Gurmukhi (the original script). 'translit' holds the Devanagari versions supplied by the owner, shown only if the customer turns transliteration on. verified=false until checked by a knowledgeable person.

items.title: Ik Onkar Satgur Prasad
items.corrected: Supplied in Devanagari; stored in Gurmukhi as requested, Devanagari kept as transliteration.

items.title: Ik Onkar Sat Naam
items.corrected: Supplied as 'ੴ एक ओंकार सतनाम', which is not a standard formulation; replaced with the opening words of the Mool Mantar. Please confirm.

items.title: Waheguru Ji
items.corrected: Supplied in Devanagari; stored in Gurmukhi.

items.title: Satnam Waheguru
items.corrected: Supplied in Devanagari; stored in Gurmukhi.

items.title: Waheguru Ji Ka Khalsa, Waheguru Ji Ki Fateh
items.text:
ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕਾ ਖਾਲਸਾ ॥
ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਫਤਹਿ ॥
items.translit: ॥ वाहेगुरु जी का खालसा, वाहेगुरु जी की फतेह ॥
items.corrected: Supplied in Devanagari; stored in Gurmukhi.

items.title: Mool Mantar
items.text:
ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ
ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
items.translit: ੴ सतनाम करता पुरख निरभउ निरवैर अकाल मूरति अजूनी सैभं गुर प्रसादि॥
items.corrected: Supplied in Devanagari; stored in Gurmukhi as written in Sri Guru Granth Sahib.
